rubric.role_summary: Backend software engineer for a commercial property and casualty insurance platform spanning data collection, automated underwriting, and policy administration. The role leads major product initiatives, makes technical decisions, and works across the stack.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Backend software engineer for a commercial property and casualty insurance platform spanning data collection, automated underwriting, and policy administration. The role leads major product initiatives, makes technical decisions, and works across the stack.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience leading or making a major contribution to significant projects.
- Some insurance experience, either in an InsurTech or actuarial role.
- Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript in backend and/or frontend work.
- At least 5+ years of working experience delivering products; full-stack engineering experience is preferred.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Onsite work is based in one of these areas.

location.requirement_text: Location: San Francisco Bay Area, California. Onsite work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.

soft_requirements: Comfort with ambiguity, frequent shipping, varied responsibilities, and end-to-end ownership.
Interest in the built world, construction safety, and productivity.
Willingness to mentor other engineers and adapt views when presented with better solutions.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Passion for the work and attention to technical quality and customer impact.
